verdict.rationale: Google Drive exposes a comprehensive, well-documented public REST API (v3) with detailed guides for uploads, sharing/permissions, search, custom properties, push notifications, and OAuth scoping, enabling programmatic control of nearly all Drive functionality. missing for 10: no discoverable llms.txt or standard OpenAPI spec file (probe 404s), and no independent hands-on developer corroboration of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
